fact: The Department of Immigration & Civil Status, with the Department of Information Communications Technology, issues the NIN and ID letters and from 17 September 2024 issues virtual ID cards on the SeyID platform instead of physical cards for permit holders.
source_slug: 2024-09-18 Launch of New Digital Solutions for Public Services

fact: The ICS says it continues to issue the National Identity Number and, from 17 September 2024, no longer issues physical ID cards to permit holders, who use the SEYID virtual ID.
The Department of Immigration and Civil Status issues, replaces and amends the National Identity Card at its ID Card Offices in Victoria and Grand Anse Praslin, per its FAQ.
The Civil Status Division of the Department of Immigration and Civil Status prepares and issues Identity Cards to all residents and holds the National Population Database.
